newsitem.title: USA: Talley Industries Inc Q4 loss vs profit.
newsitem.headline: Talley Industries Inc Q4 loss vs profit.

text.p: (A) Revenue and earnings include impact of the $156.4 million payments received in connection with the recently concluded litigation with TRW Inc.

(B) Earnings before income taxes and extraordinary items for the twelve months ended Dec. 31, 1996, include a provision for a real estate reserve of $85.0 million, resulting from a determination that a bulk sale and/or joint venture development arrangement for real estate assets should be undertaken. Earnings for 1995 include a provision for a real estate reserve of $7.0 million. (C) The extraordinary loss for the three months and twelve months ended Dec. 31, 1996, represents a prepayment premium and deferred debt cost associated with the company's Senior Discount Debentures, repurchased during the period. Extraordinary gains for the three month and twelve month period ended Dec. 31, 1995, is the result of the retirement of real estate debt for less than book value. (D) Amount does not impact net earnings of the company but represents the estimated value of additional shares issued to induce conversion and is supplementally disclosed as a reduction of amounts available to common shareholders, pursuant to SEC rules.
